name: io.fless/mcp
title: Fless Apartment Hunt
description: Apartment hunting across 16 US states: rents, briefs, hunt links.

tools.name: search_cities
tools.description: List cities where Fless operates (live + coming soon). Returns ids needed for hunts.

tools.name: get_city_overview
tools.description: Neighborhood-level overview of a live city: median rents (1BR/2BR), walk/transit/bike scores per neighborhood.

tools.name: get_neighborhood
tools.description: Full detail for one neighborhood: rents, scores, POI counts, descriptions, nearby neighborhoods.

tools.name: get_hunt_requirements
tools.description: Every hunt field, enum, and rule; canonical amenity keys; binary restrictions (55+, pets, smoking); transparent credit pricing. Read this before collecting a hunt brief.

city.description: Optional city to pin the brief to

tools.name: build_hunt_link
tools.description: Validate a hunt brief and get a URL that pre-fills the full hunt form for the human. Works with partial briefs (missing_fields lists what to collect).

hunt_params.description: Hunt brief per get_hunt_requirements (city_id, min_price, max_price, bedrooms, move_in_date, proximity_criteria[], amenities{}, additional_questions[])

tools.name: check_hunt_link
tools.description: Aggregate status of a hunt link (created/opened/started) — no personal data.

tools.name: request_city
tools.description: Request that Fless expand to a new city. Use when the user's target city is not currently served (check live coverage first with search_cities). Returns the total request count for that city. No account or email needed.

tools.name: get_city_request_stats
tools.description: See which cities have been requested most. Useful for telling users whether their city has demand.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Fless content (cities, neighborhoods, hunt guide). Returns citable ids for fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch full content by id from search: markdown text + canonical url for citations.

tools.name: submit_error_report
tools.description: Report a problem with Fless tools or data so we can fix it. Include: the tool you called, the error code from the error contract if present, what happened vs what you expected. Do NOT include personal data.

error_type.description: What kind of problem this is.

tool_name.description: The tool (or surface) the problem occurred on.

error_code.description: Error code from the error contract, if present (e.g. CITY_NOT_FOUND). Omit when absent.

what_happened.description: Factual description of what happened (plain text, no personal data, 10-1000 chars).

what_expected.description: What you expected to happen instead (optional).

tools.name: realtor_list_clients
tools.description: Realtor tool: requires Authorization: Bearer with an API key (create one at fless.io/realtor under API keys); anonymous calls return the structured UNAUTHORIZED error. Accepted clients (id, name, email) + pending invitations (email, expires).

tools.name: realtor_create_client
tools.description: Realtor tool: requires Authorization: Bearer with an API key (create one at fless.io/realtor under API keys); anonymous calls return the structured UNAUTHORIZED error. Invite a client by email; the invitation email carries a 7-day accept link. Gated on an active subscription/trial.

tools.name: realtor_create_hunt
tools.description: Realtor tool: requires Authorization: Bearer with an API key (create one at fless.io/realtor under API keys); anonymous calls return the structured UNAUTHORIZED error. Create a hunt FOR one of your clients (fields mirror get_hunt_requirements). Returns hunt_id + matched_count; the hunt parks at awaiting_realtor_curation. Gated on an active subscription/trial.

name.description: Optional hunt name; when omitted it is derived from bedrooms + the hunt's POIs (e.g. '2 bed near Logan Circle').

client_user_id.description: Your client's user id (realtor_list_clients). Provide client_user_id OR client_email.

client_email.description: Alternative to client_user_id: the client's linked email

proximity_criteria.description: POIs the hunt centers on (name, latitude, longitude, category?, max_distance miles 0.1-10)

tools.name: realtor_list_candidate_buildings
tools.description: Realtor tool: requires Authorization: Bearer with an API key (create one at fless.io/realtor under API keys); anonymous calls return the structured UNAUTHORIZED error. The matched candidate list for one of your hunts (counts + buildings with eligibility, distance, and your curation status).

tools.name: realtor_curate_hunt
tools.description: Realtor tool: requires Authorization: Bearer with an API key (create one at fless.io/realtor under API keys); anonymous calls return the structured UNAUTHORIZED error. Curate the candidate list WITHOUT sending: removals [{id, reason?}] and notes [{id, internal_notes?, client_notes?}] (hunt_building ids from realtor_list_candidate_buildings). Not gated.

internal_notes.description: Private to you (never shown to the client)

client_notes.description: Shown to the client in review

tools.name: realtor_add_building_to_hunt
tools.description: Realtor tool: requires Authorization: Bearer with an API key (create one at fless.io/realtor under API keys); anonymous calls return the structured UNAUTHORIZED error. Search your hunt's building inventory by name and manually add the one unambiguous match into the hunt (several matches: top 3 are named and nothing is added).

tools.name: realtor_send_to_client
tools.description: Realtor tool: requires Authorization: Bearer with an API key (create one at fless.io/realtor under API keys); anonymous calls return the structured UNAUTHORIZED error. Send the curated list to the client: every non-removed building becomes included and the hunt moves to awaiting_client_approval (the CLIENT releases outreach). Gated on an active subscription/trial.

tools.name: realtor_get_hunt_status
tools.description: Realtor tool: requires Authorization: Bearer with an API key (create one at fless.io/realtor under API keys); anonymous calls return the structured UNAUTHORIZED error. Status of one of your hunts: review_state, counts, and the client's name.
